item.title: Officials release name of US Marine who died after training incident in Japan
item.description: Lance Cpl. Devin J. Hernandez, 25, of Maryland, died on Tuesday, officials said.

item.title: Bob Dylan comes knockin' on pope's door as Leo welcomes legend to Vatican
item.description: The American singer-songwriter and poet visited with the American pope at the Vatican during a break between concert dates in Italy. The Vatican said the encounter was brief.

item.title: France braces for fresh protests in test for Macron's policies
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of protesters are expected to march through French cities and public workers to strike on Thursday, in a fresh test for President Emmanuel Macron after weeks of ​unrest that have rattled ‌his government and dominated the agenda five months ahead of a presidential election.

item.title: Live: France braces for nationwide strikes in fresh test for Macron’s policies
item.description: Strikes and demonstrations are planned across France on Thursday, with trade unions urging the government to support households struggling with rising living costs. The nationwide action follows weeks of social unrest. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

item.title: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 years in prison
item.description: Wong was sentenced for his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law, in a case that critics say reflects the crackdown on the city's once-thriving pro-democracy movement.

item.title: WATCH: David Muir on how a high school's auto shop is bringing Houston together
item.description: A student-run automotive shop has opened to the public – giving high schoolers hands-on experience with oil changes, tire rotations and multi-point inspections.

item.title: Melania Trump to host Ukrainian, Russian officials at White House
item.description: Russian and Ukrainian officials, including human rights chiefs, are set to meet US First Lady Melania Trump at the White House Thursday ahead of Abu Dhabi talks aimed at ending the Ukraine war. It comes weeks after Melania Trump helped broker a partial ceasefire enabling the evacuation of civilians from the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky.

item.title: Multiple bears may have killed mother and daughter in Canada
item.description: A mother and daughter have been killed in an attack in Canada that authorities say may have involved multiple grizzly bears.

item.title: Almost 75% of Britons view US as serious threat to global peace
item.description: Almost three-quarters of Britons believe the US to be a serious threat to global peace - more than double the figure from two years ago - according to a new survey.

item.title: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong gets 10 more years in jail for foreign collusion
item.description: Hong Kong democracy activist Joshua Wong was sentenced to 10 more years in prison on Thursday for colluding with foreign powers, a court summary said. Wong, 30, pleaded guilty in September to seeking foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China under Beijing’s national security law, having spent nearly six years imprisoned.

item.title: South Korea to deploy military mission to keep Strait of Hormuz open
item.description: South Korea will deploy maritime patrol aircraft and an explosive ordnance disposal team near the Strait of Hormuz to help keep the waterway open, its defence ministry said Thursday. Seoul said it would protect commercial shipping and energy supplies while ruling out military intervention in the ongoing US-Iran war.

item.title: UK agrees to talks on harms of the transatlantic slave trade
item.description: The UK has agreed to engage in "structured, time-bound, inclusive and good-faith" talks that address the "historical harms" of the transatlantic slave trade, Commonwealth leaders have said.

item.title: LIVE: ABC News Live
item.description: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

item.title: Black candidates from both parties made history in midterm elections
item.description: Black candidates from both political parties made history in 2026, with six governors set to serve across U.S. states and new key milestones in Congress.

item.title: These candidates made history in the 2026 midterm elections
item.description: The midterms saw an expansion of representation among America's lawmakers, with several candidates celebrating groundbreaking wins.

item.title: Trump dismisses prospect of replacing Hegseth amid Iran war fallout
item.description: Trump's remarks come as Republicans grapple with the political fallout from the eight-month war with Iran.

item.title: WATCH: What to know after Democrats take back control of Congress
item.description: ABC News political contributors Amanda Renteria, a Democratic strategist, and Ramesh Ponnuru, editor of the National Review, share more about what's being called a "blue tsunami."

item.title: DOJ drops charges against Russian researcher accused of smuggling frog embryos
item.description: A judge has granted a request from prosecutors to drop the criminal case against Kseniia Petrova, the Russian researcher accused of smuggling frog embryos into the U.S.

item.title: Champions League: Real Madrid seal late comeback as Liverpool lose to Fenerbahce
item.description: Real Madrid maintained their perfect Champions League record as Federico Valverde’s stoppage-time strike secured a 3-2 comeback win at AEK Athens on Wednesday. Madrid twice trailed before Valverde scored from long range in the 92nd minute. Liverpool’s winning start ended with a surprise 3-2 defeat at Fenerbahce in the competition.

item.title: WATCH: What to know about the Colorado congressional races
item.description: Democrat Jason Crow won his reelection for Colorado's 6th District, beating Republican challenger Jason Clark.

item.title: WATCH: Where do Republicans go from here?
item.description: ABC News contributors Cristina Tzintzun Ramirez, a Democratic strategist, and Sonny Joy Nelson, a former special assistant to President Trump, share their takeaways from last night's results.

item.title: Where voters stand on state ballot measures, from abortion to LGBTQ rights to guns
item.description: Voters in dozens of states considered 146 statewide ballot measures this midterm cycle, on topics spanning LGBTQ rights, wealth taxes, abortion, redistricting, guns and more.

item.title: New senator may have made a misstep in this viral video
item.description: All news is local now. I suppose that's one lesson from my encounter with Abdul El-Sayed.

item.title: Netanyahu claims 'serious concerns' of foreign spending to sway Israeli election
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Wednesday cited "serious suspicions" around foreign interference in Israel's recent parliamentary elections. He claims foreign countries spent large amounts of money to influence the results, while the largest Arab-Israeli bloc called such accusations "political persecution".

item.title: South Africans vote in key municipal elections
item.description: In tonight's edition, a crucial test for South Africa's ruling ANC as millions vote to elect municipal governments. Also, Ethiopia has expelled six Sudanese diplomats amid accusations it's allowing the paramilitary RSF to launch drone strikes from its territory. And a deepening humanitarian crisis in Ethiopia, where renewed fighting has displaced thousands.

item.title: Elon Musk will face scrutiny from Democrats after midterms
item.description: Democrats are likely to launch investigations into Musk's influence, including his leadership of DOGE and government contracts

item.title: Musk-backed candidates lose midterms despite financial backing
item.description: Shares of Tesla and SpaceX dropped after the Democratic party swept to power in America's midterm elections. Their founder, tech titan Elon Musk, poured over $440 million into Republican candidates and causes, the single biggest campaign donor in the election cycle. But his investment fell flat, as his preferred candidates lost races in Texas, where he has put down roots.

item.title: Democratic leaders reflect on midterm results and what's next for the party
item.description: Democratic party leaders and political analysts spoke with Morning Edition about the results of the midterm elections, the effects of mid-decade redistricting efforts, and the next steps for the party.

item.title: It was a big night for doctors to win seats in Congress, riding the blue wave
item.description: Historically, most physicians who served in the House or Senate have been Republicans. In the next Congress, physicians who are Democrats made significant gains.

item.title: Trump’s second-term playbook: Fake news, AI and attacks on his critics
item.description: Donald Trump could be credited with popularising the term "fake news", but his own presidency has been riddled with numerous false claims, conspiracy theories and misleading content. In this special fact-checking segment, Vedika Bahl examines his Trump's second term: his consistent attacks on political opponents, use of AI-generated images to glorify himself and push political narratives, and what happens when journalists challenge him.

item.title: WATCH: Candidates make midterms history
item.description: Keisha Lance Bottoms, David Crowley and Byron Donalds are projected to become the first Black governors elected in Georgia, Wisconsin and Florida.

item.title: How Chinese AI is censoring the controversy around Mbappé’s Chairman Mao comments
item.description: Footballer Kylian Mbappé sparked a wave of condemnation across China when he implied that Chinese leader Mao Zedong was a dictator. In China, information about this controversy is being censored by Chinese AI chatbots.

item.title: Navajo voters hop tractors, make extraordinary efforts to vote after widespread flooding
item.description: Four weeks of flooding washed out roads and sent thousands fleeing their homes on the Navajo Reservation. But many worked hard to get to polling places and voting day became part of the recovery process.

item.title: Herbert Blomstedt, conductor of great orchestras for seven decades, dies at 99
item.description: Modest in his demeanor but remarkably enduring, the American-born, Swedish conductor continually fell in love with music, leading orchestras with no-nonsense insight and integrity well into his 90s.

item.title: Repudiation of Trump, economic pain drove Dems to House victory: Voter Poll analysis
item.description: Democrats are projected to retake the House for the first time since 2020.

item.title: Blue wave across America: do US midterms signal beginning of the end for Trump?
item.description: He asked voters to pretend he was on the ballot and they did. Voters across the United States chasing Donald Trump's Republican majorities from both houses of Congress. How big a landslide for the Democrats?

item.title: Russia attacks Ukrainian aid hub in one of the deadliest strikes since war began
item.description: Russian strikes on an aid hub killed at least 40 people - making it one of Russia's deadliest attacks on Ukrainian civilians since the full-scale invasion began, officials said.

item.title: Voters elect female governors in 17 states, setting new record
item.description: Women will serve as governors for the first time in states including Tennessee and Georgia.

item.title: Chuck Schumer heralds Democrats' 'generational remake' of Senate
item.description: In remarks the day after his party flipped control of Congress, the Senate Minority Leader said voters had spoken clearly about their priorities, and said it's up to the Democratic party to deliver.

item.title: Three men arrested after suspected murder of non-league footballer
item.description: Three men have been arrested after the death of a "talented" and "inspirational" non-league footballer.

item.title: Mike Johnson will step aside as top House Republican next Congress
item.description: After Tuesday's bruising defeat for Republicans, House Speaker Mike Johnson will not stay on as minority leader come January.

item.title: Democrats warn Trump camp to ‘lawyer up’ as anger over corruption drives midterms wipeout
item.description: Corruption in government was high on the minds of US voters as they dealt US President Donald Trump’s party a chastening defeat in midterm elections, toppling Republican strongholds like dominoes and flipping both chambers of Congress. Triumphant Democrats have warned the Trump administration to “lawyer up”; how they go about tackling alleged graft and abuse of power could shape both their own fortunes and the country’s politics.

item.title: Billionaire tax: What to know about California's Prop 40
item.description: The measure would levy a one-time, 5% tax on the wealth of billionaires in California.

item.title: 'Once-in-a-generation event: Historic election a shocking repudiation of Trump & the MAGA movement'
item.description: Erin Ogunkeye is pleased to welcome Adam Jentleson, President of the Searchlight Institute and author of Supermajority: How Democrats Can Build Lasting Power, For Jentleson, the Democrats' sweeping midterm victory represents far more than the familiar backlash against an incumbent president. "This is a once-in-a-generation event." But electoral breadth presents a governing dilemma. Can a coalition stretching from progressive reformers to culturally conservative Democrats translate its diversity into legislative action? "Pluralism is not just a political strategy. It is actually a moral good in a democracy," he insists. But electoral breadth presents a governing dilemma. Can a coalition stretching from progressive reformers to culturally conservative Democrats translate its diversity into legislative action? And can a party united by opposition to Trump sustain that unity when confronted with difficult choices over healthcare, immigration, economic inequality and climate change?

item.title: WATCH: Sen. Cory Booker sees 'big realignment' of US after Democrats' win
item.description: The New Jersey senator says Democrats now need to "deliver on the things that all of America wants right now."

item.title: European leaders welcome Democrats' US midterms election win
item.description: European leaders voiced hopes for a reset with the United States on Wednesday, November 4, after voters delivered a huge midterm election defeat to President Donald Trump and his Republican party. FRANCE 24's Dave Keating has more.

item.title: US midterms bring a wave of historic firsts as minorities win key races
item.description: US midterms bring a wave of historic firsts as minorities win key races: The first Native American female senator in Minnesota, the first openly gay male senator in New Hampshire, the first Muslim senator in Michigan and the country's first Black female governor in Georgia. FRANCE 24's Elitsa Gadeva has more.

item.title: US midterms: Iran's deputy parliament speaker reacts to Trump's elections setback
item.description: First Deputy Speaker of the Parliament of Iran Ali Nikzad on Wednesday attributed Republican losses in the US midterm elections to Washington's war with Iran, telling lawmakers that American efforts to pressure Tehran had failed. Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in Tuesday's midterm elections.

item.title: REPLAY: Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer on US midterms
item.description: The US Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer talked to the press after the midterm election results. Democrats are riding their sweep of Congress into a new era, eager to meet voter demands for change with plans to tackle high costs of living and confront President Donald Trump's final years in the White House.

item.title: US Midterms: How will Trump manage working with Democrats?
item.description: Democrats are riding their sweep of Congress into a new era, eager to meet voter demands for change with plans to tackle high costs of living. How will Donald Trump manage to work with them? FRANCE 24's Ophelie Jacobson has more.

item.title: Goalkeeper involved in collision with Spanish footballer who died releases statement
item.description: A goalkeeper involved in an on-field collision with a Spanish footballer who died says he is "going through the most difficult ‌days of his life".

item.title: Tale of 2 midterms: Republican redistricting 'backfired' while Democrats 'exceeded all expectations'
item.description: Following a resounding Midterm election defeat, Is MAGA Losing Its Grip on the Republican Party? Erin Ogunkeye is pleased to welcome Bryan Lanza, Republican strategist and Partner in Mercury's Washington DC office. "The big thing about MAGA was confrontation, in your face," explained Lanza. But following a veritable blue wave, he believes the electorate has delivered a warning: "We need to move beyond that." While Donald Trump has acknowledged the Democratic victory, at times combative, at times conciliatory, Lanza argues that the president must begin his final two years in office reversing damaging tariffs, addressing widespread dissatisfaction with immigration enforcement and navigating a highly unpopular Iran war.

item.title: WATCH: The many firsts in the midterms
item.description: Senior Political Correspondent Rachel Scott on a big night of firsts in the 2026 midterm elections.

item.title: Texas Democrat James Talarico speaks out after projected win against Paxton
item.description: Texas Senator-elect James Talarico says the Democratic sweep in the midterm elections goes beyond party lines.

item.title: Trump after the midterms: Gridlock, impeachment and succession?
item.description: Following the US midterms, US President Donald Trump could face a turbulent final two years in office. From budget battles to potential impeachment proceedings, what does the new political balance of power mean for his presidency? FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Philip Turle breaks it down.

item.title: US midterm elections: 'Maybe the best colour for Texas is purple'
item.description: Texas flipped blue following the US midterm elections, marking a historic shift for a state that hasn't been led by Democrats in decades. The legacy of prolonged Republican leadership has left a lasting mark, but as Democrat James Talarico said with this election, 'maybe the best colour for Texas is purple.' FRANCE 24's Texas correspondent Andres Espinal reports.

item.title: Trump says he was 'a little bit surprised' after Democrats' big win in midterms
item.description: The president also said he was willing to work with Democrats.

item.description: ABC News' Maggie Rulli reports on the international reaction to a decisive rebuke of President Donald Trump.

item.title: WATCH: Martin Luther King Jr.'s granddaughter votes for 1st time
item.description: 18-year-old Yolanda Renee King, the granddaughter of Martin Luther King Jr. and Coretta Scott King, has cast a ballot in her very first election in Atlanta.

item.title: WATCH: Who turned out to vote, and why?
item.description: Senior Political Correspondent Rachel Scott breaks down what we know about the election results and the messages voters are sending.

item.description: A husband who drugged and raped his wife for 21 years was a 'monster' who lived a double life, a court has heard.

item.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson made remarks after ABC News projected Democrats will win enough seats to take control of the House.

item.description: A British citizen in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for Ebola and will be brought back to the UK for treatment.

item.description: The Democrats have won control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate, Sky's US partner NBC News has projected.

item.description: Spain's transport minister has said he will step down after two deadly train crashes in less than a year.

item.description: A British adventurer who has been walking around the world for almost three decades returned to his childhood home Monday.

item.title: Spanish footballer dies after on-field collision
item.description: Tenerife football player Jesus de Miguel has died after suffering a cardiac arrest following an on-field collision in a match on Monday.

item.description: The US military has carried out "limited strikes" on Qeshm Island in Iran - hours before the midterms are due to take place.
